facts: Validation certifies a course or level after passing the relevant examinations.
The process for under-18s is free; the parent or legal guardian must submit the application.
Applications can be submitted online or at the appropriate Ayuda Mineduc office; NEE applications are in person.
The family must review requirements and current dates; authorizations depend on places being available.
Contact the assigned examination establishment at least ten business days before the examination period.
